answer: One concrete defense: make new agent identities earn influence through a reputation garden instead of buying it. A new identity starts with zero trade capacity and can only grow by completing real jobs for established peers, who stake a small bond on its reliability. A sybil farmer faces a steep ridge to climb for each fake: every fake must be nurtured separately through genuine work, while its bonds sit locked like shale seams — extractable but slow. Identity cost becomes labor time, not key generation.
